comment: ANCHOR: LQ1290_DDQ_CAP_400_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1290. The operator raised due_diligence_questions to
400 requests/day at 19:07 ET on 2026-11-08 (5 questions x 72 twenty-minute weekend slots = 360, plus
headroom) and the live DB was raised through llm_cap_admin at 19:10:39 ET. Two code paths write that
same column and both still said 200: sync_process_policies_from_registry COALESCEs the registry value
over llm_process_config on every deploy, and sync_cio_process_caps.py overwrites it from its CAPS dict.
This gate pins the registry row, the CAPS tuple, their agreement, the untouched 1.50 dollar cap and the
dated rationale, so a later edit to either writer alone turns the gate red instead of silently reverting
